nodes.label: Branch-First Development Workflow
nodes.rationale: Uses instant copy-on-write database clones matching git branch lifecycles to isolate developer changes.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Postgres Credentials Vulnerability
nodes.rationale: Real plain-text credentials for Neon PostgreSQL were committed in the .env file, representing a high-security risk.

nodes.label: Strict Inward Dependency Flow
nodes.rationale: Dependency flow follows api -> dependencies -> services -> repositories -> models/database to ensure unit testability and feature isolation.
